envelope.title: D-122 · Keep a partner claim reference
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-122 is about Claims Automation: keep a partner claim reference so support can trace the original claim.
